|game_text=At each system a player controls with a capital starship, non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles) deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of Let's Go Left (V), the text of the Virtual Block 5 release sheet. Other versions: [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, the current text). The image here is the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-33E-Lets_Go_Left.png]]), which shows this text. The first printing of September 2009 is lost; see the history below.
* '''First printing''' (September 2009): lost. The card was first issued when the Players Committee realigned its Virtual Sets into Virtual Blocks in September 2009<ref name="pc-news-2009-09-16">Players Committee news post “Virtual Set 6: Reflections 4 and Errata Released (Updated)”, 16 September 2009 (the Virtual Sets realigned into Virtual Blocks 1–5). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090706102746/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/news/news.php?id=70 Internet Archive]</ref>. No copy of that first printing survives, so its text is not known and it has no page here (versions ruling of 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-letsgoleft-pre.gif]], slip number 01E, errata mark E) prints: “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, their non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles) deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).” The same image is in Lee Edwards' V-kit, committed on 9 December 2009<ref name="vkit-r1">Lee Edwards' Star Wars CCG V-kit (swccgvkit-legacy), slip image <code>public/images/vslips/virtual14-light/letsgoleft.png</code> (slip #01E), in Subversion revision 1, committed 9 December 2009 (<code>.svn/entries</code>; [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit-legacy/tree/81e004826e5697f45d10c4330f78ff8136dae46f/public/images/vslips GitHub copy])</ref>, so it was made by then. The PC website card list stamps the card “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”<ref name="cl-1250_33-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>; this wording is that errata of 9 September 2009 (versions ruling of 11 November 2026). It is the earliest surviving text of the card.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009) dropped “their”: “non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles)” (without “their”, the discount names no owner, so it applies to both players' cards): “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, non-[Presence] characters (and vehicles) deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 4, slip 33E. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-33E-Lets_Go_Left.png]]) shows this text. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a version, because the PC website card list already showed PC-E3.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Let's Go Left (V) (Errata 3)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013), where the entry is marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”, put “their” back and dropped the parentheses: “their non-[Presence] characters and vehicles”: “At each system a player controls with a capital starship, their non-[Presence] characters and vehicles deploy -1 to related sites and sectors. If you occupy a system with a capital starship (or three unique starships) and have no Objective on table, may add 1 to each of your Force drains at related battleground sites (opponent loses no more than 2 Force from those drains).”<ref name="cl-1250_33-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> It is the latest text, so it is the current text.
